falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured VIX peaking at 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 indicates a systemic credit event or liquidation cascade, not a tactical bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further by >25bps from current level (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with steepening curve as recession fears peaked; renewed flattening/inversion signals bond market pricing a harder landing, invalidating the 'soft landing bottom' analog

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below its August 5, 2024 low (5167.51) on any daily close
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A pattern match requires the current structure to hold above the prior panic low; breaking below it confirms this is not a fractal repeat but a lower-low continuation of downtrend

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
